message.content: {"note_claim": "OpenAI claims its AI solved the Navier-Stokes Millennium Prize Problem, and OpenAI denies that its proof builds on Buckmaster and Alpöge's work.", "label": "SUPPORTS", "quote": "We (the researchers and the agents) did not see any of their work through any means until they released it publicly — in particular, no specific user data was accessed in order to solve this problem.", "reason": "The OpenAI page states it is sharing a Navier–Stokes solution and denies that Buckmaster's or Alpöge's work or data influenced it."}

parsed.note_claim: OpenAI claims its AI solved the Navier-Stokes Millennium Prize Problem, and OpenAI denies that its proof builds on Buckmaster and Alpöge's work.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: We (the researchers and the agents) did not see any of their work through any means until they released it publicly — in particular, no specific user data was accessed in order to solve this problem.
parsed.reason: The OpenAI page states it is sharing a Navier–Stokes solution and denies that Buckmaster's or Alpöge's work or data influenced it.
